title: Rav Acha bar Bivi Mar
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yevamot 8a, where he said to Ravina: “Thus we say in Rava’s name.”[^1]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Yevamot 8a explicitly has Rav Acha bar Bivi Mar addressing Ravina and saying, “Thus we say in Rava’s name.” The direction of address and attribution is retained. Mar remains in Hyman’s name form without an identity resolution or additional legal material.
